name: Smart Tool Creator
promise: Turn what you know into a tool.
description: Package domain expertise as an Amplifier Smart Tool. Start with a working structure, add intelligent capabilities, and check the result against the specification.
alt: Illustration of three stages: scaffold a library, add domain expertise, and check the tool against the specification.
caption: From domain expertise to a tool another agent can use. Process illustration.
flow_title: Build the capability. Share the expertise.
flow_intro: Move the knowledge in your skills, bundles, or workflows into a standalone library and CLI.
steps: Scaffold a Git repository with the package, manifest, library, and CLI the specification calls for.
Describe a model-backed capability and the context it needs. Smart Tool Creator implements it and runs the tool's own checks.
Run the conformance kit, then review the design against the specification for actionable improvements.
detail_title: A foundation for the tools you want to make.
details: Make capabilities available to applications, agents, and scripts through a library with a thin command-line interface.
Scaffold the manifest and skill-format help so another agent can discover the tool and learn how to call it.
Get rule-by-rule conformance results and a model-backed review of the parts of the specification that need judgment.
prompt: Use Smart Tool Creator to package my domain expertise as an Amplifier Smart Tool. Read smart-tool-creator --help, help me define the capability, scaffold the project, and check it against the specification.
prerequisites: Python 3.13+, uv 0.9.17 or newer, and Git.
model_note: Model-backed implementation and review use GitHub Copilot through your signed-in GitHub CLI account.
title: Smart Tool Creator | Amplifier Smart Tools
